description: Scrape YouTube video comments with full metadata including author info, likes, timestamps, and reply threads.

commentKeywordFilter.description: Only return comments (and their replies) whose text contains this word or phrase (case-insensitive). Leave empty to return all comments. A top-level comment that doesn't match is skipped entirely, so its replies are not checked or fetched.
commentKeywordFilter.title: Comment Keyword Filter

includeReplies.description: Whether to fetch reply threads for each comment.
includeReplies.title: Include Replies

maxComments.description: Maximum number of top-level comments to scrape per video. Replies are fetched separately and do not count toward this limit.
maxComments.title: Max Comments Per Video

maxRepliesPerComment.description: Maximum number of replies to fetch per top-level comment. Set to 0 to skip replies even if Include Replies is enabled.
maxRepliesPerComment.title: Max Replies Per Comment

minLikeCount.description: Only return comments and replies with at least this many likes. Set to 0 to disable.
minLikeCount.title: Minimum Like Count

sortBy.description: How to sort comments. 'Top comments' shows most relevant/liked first. 'Newest first' shows chronologically newest.
sortBy.title: Sort Comments By

videoUrls.description: YouTube video URLs, short links (youtu.be), shorts URLs, or plain video IDs.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs

title: YouTube Comment Scraper Input
